questions.question_hindi:
'राष्ट्रीय हरित हाइड्रोजन मिशन' के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
(a) भारत का लक्ष्य 2030 तक सालाना 50 लाख मीट्रिक टन हरित हाइड्रोजन का उत्पादन करना है।
(b) राजस्थान को उसकी उच्च सौर ऊर्जा क्षमता के कारण एक संभावित हरित हाइड्रोजन केंद्र के रूप में पहचाना गया है।
(c) इस मिशन में वित्तीय प्रोत्साहन प्रदान करने के लिए एस.आई.जी.एच.टी. (हरित हाइड्रोजन संक्रमण के लिए रणनीतिक हस्तक्षेप) कार्यक्रम शामिल है।
(d) 2026 तक भारत के सभी घरों में हरित हाइड्रोजन का उपयोग करना अनिवार्य है।
questions.question_english:
Which of the following statements are correct with reference to the 'National Green Hydrogen Mission'?
(a) India aims to produce 5 million metric tonnes of green hydrogen annually by 2030.
(b) Rajasthan has been identified as a potential Green Hydrogen Hub due to its high solar energy potential.
(c) The mission includes the SIGHT (Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition) programme to provide financial incentives.
(d) It is mandatory for all households in India to use green hydrogen by 2026.
questions.technical_proof: Statement (d) is false — there is no mandate for all households to use green hydrogen by 2026. Statements (a), (b) and (c) are all factually correct about the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
questions.explanation: The National Green Hydrogen Mission targets 5 MMTPA production by 2030. Rajasthan is a identified hub due to solar potential. SIGHT programme provides financial incentives. Statement (d) is incorrect — no such mandate exists.
questions.trap_point: Statement (d) sounds plausible but no such household mandate exists.
questions.memory_trick: SIGHT = Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition — incentives, not mandates.
questions.revision_fact: India's National Green Hydrogen Mission target: 5 MMTPA by 2030; includes SIGHT programme.

questions.question_hindi:
'डीप ओशन मिशन' (डी.ओ.एम.) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
(a) यह दुर्लभ खनिजों के लिए समुद्र तल का पता लगाने का एक लक्ष्य है।
(b) मत्स्य 6000 इसके लिए डिजाइन किया गया मानवयुक्त पनडुब्बी वाहन है।
(c) इसका नेतृत्व पृथ्वी विज्ञान मंत्रालय द्वारा किया जाता है।
(d) इस मिशन का मुख्य उद्देश्य गहरे समुद्र के तल से तेल निकालना है।
questions.question_english:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding the 'Deep Ocean Mission' (DOM)?
(a) It is a mission to explore the ocean floor for rare minerals.
(b) The MATSYA 6000 is the manned submersible vehicle designed for this.
(c) It is spearheaded by the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
(d) The mission primarily aims to extract oil from deep-sea beds.
questions.technical_proof: Statement (d) is false — DOM is NOT for oil extraction. It focuses on rare minerals, polymetallic nodules etc. (a), (b), (c) are all correct facts.
questions.explanation: Deep Ocean Mission is led by Ministry of Earth Sciences. MATSYA 6000 is the manned submersible. The mission explores rare minerals, not oil. Statement (d) is incorrect.
questions.trap_point: Confusing rare mineral exploration with oil extraction.
questions.memory_trick: DOM = Deep Ocean Minerals (not oil). MATSYA 6000 = manned sub, Ministry of Earth Sciences.
questions.revision_fact: Deep Ocean Mission: Ministry of Earth Sciences, MATSYA 6000 submersible, targets rare minerals.

questions.question_hindi:
ऊपर दी गई तालिका तीन महीनों के दौरान विभिन्न उत्पादों की बिक्री को दर्शाती है। जनवरी में हुई कुल उत्पाद बिक्री की तुलना में मार्च में हुई कुल उत्पाद बिक्री में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई है?
(उत्पाद A: Jan=120, Feb=150, Mar=180; B: Jan=200, Feb=180, Mar=160; C: Jan=100, Feb=120, Mar=140; D: Jan=80, Feb=100, Mar=120)
questions.question_english:
The above table shows the sales of different products over three months. What is percentage increase in total product sales in March compared to total product sales in January?
(Product A: Jan=120, Feb=150, Mar=180; B: Jan=200, Feb=180, Mar=160; C: Jan=100, Feb=120, Mar=140; D: Jan=80, Feb=100, Mar=120)
questions.explanation: Jan total = 500, March total = 600. Increase = 100. % increase = (100/500)×100 = 20%.
questions.trap_point: Students may add wrong months or miss a product row.
questions.memory_trick: Sum all Jan = 500, Sum all Mar = 600 → 20% rise.
questions.revision_fact: Always total all products before computing percentage change in DI questions.

questions.question_hindi: राज्य वित्त आयोग (SFC) की नियुक्ति राज्यपाल द्वारा, किनके बीच संसाधनों के वितरण की अनुशंसा करने हेतु की जाती है?
questions.question_english: The State Finance Commission (SFC) is appointed by the Governor to recommend the distribution of resources between:
questions.technical_proof: As per Article 243-I and 243-Y of the Indian Constitution, the State Finance Commission recommends distribution of resources between the State Government and local bodies (Panchayats and Municipalities).
questions.explanation: SFC is constitutionally mandated under Articles 243-I (Panchayats) and 243-Y (Municipalities) to recommend financial distribution between State and Local Bodies.
questions.trap_point: Do not confuse SFC (State-Local Bodies) with Finance Commission (Centre-State).
questions.memory_trick: SFC = State ↔ Local Bodies. Finance Commission = Centre ↔ State.
questions.revision_fact: State Finance Commission → recommends resources between State & Local Bodies (Panchayats/Municipalities).

questions.question_hindi:
सूची-I (पद) का सूची-II (भूमिका) के साथ मिलान कीजिए:
(a) राज्यपाल → (i) राज्य के राजनीतिक प्रमुख
(b) मुख्यमंत्री → (ii) राज्य का संवैधानिक प्रमुख
(c) मुख्य सचिव → (iii) जिले के प्रशासनिक प्रमुख
(d) जिला कलेक्टर → (iv) राज्य सिविल सेवाओं के प्रमुख
questions.question_english:
Match List-I (Post) with List-II (Role):
(a) Governor → (i) Political Head of State
(b) Chief Minister → (ii) Constitutional Head of State
(c) Chief Secretary → (iii) Administrative Head of District
(d) District Collector → (iv) Head of State Civil Services
questions.technical_proof: Governor = Constitutional Head of State (not political). Chief Minister = Political Head of State. Chief Secretary = Head of State Civil Services (IAS cadre head). District Collector = Administrative Head of District. So: (a)-(ii), (b)-(i), (c)-(iv), (d)-(iii) → that is option D. However checking the printed options again: Option C: (a)-(i), (b)-(ii), (c)-(iv), (d)-(iii) — this swaps Governor and CM roles. Option D: (a)-(ii), (b)-(i), (c)-(iv), (d)-(iii) — Governor=Constitutional Head, CM=Political Head, CS=Head Civil Services, DC=Admin Head of District. Option D is constitutionally correct.
questions.explanation: Governor is the Constitutional Head of State; Chief Minister is the Political Head of State; Chief Secretary heads State Civil Services; District Collector is Administrative Head of District. Correct match: (a)-(ii), (b)-(i), (c)-(iv), (d)-(iii) = Option D.
questions.trap_point: Many students confuse Governor (Constitutional Head) with Political Head. CM is political head, not Governor.
questions.memory_trick: Governor = Constitution (appointed, not elected). CM = Political (elected leader).
questions.revision_fact: Governor = Constitutional Head; CM = Political Head; Chief Secretary = Head of State Civil Services; DC = Admin Head of District.
questions.review_status: Needs Review - Answer key may be D not C

questions.question_hindi:
अभिकथन (A): राज्यपाल राज्य विधानसभा को भंग कर सकते हैं।
कारण (R): राज्यपाल मुख्यमंत्री की सलाह पर ऐसा करते हैं।
questions.question_english:
Assertion (A): The Governor can dissolve the State Assembly.
Reason (R): The Governor does so on the advice of the Chief Minister.

options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A).

questions.technical_proof: Both (A) and (R) are true. The Governor can dissolve the State Legislative Assembly (Art. 174), and does so on the advice of the Chief Minister (Council of Ministers). (R) correctly explains (A).
questions.explanation: Governor dissolves the Assembly on the advice of the CM/Council of Ministers. Both statements are true and R correctly explains A.
questions.trap_point: Some think Governor dissolves assembly independently — but it requires CM's advice.
questions.memory_trick: Governor acts on CM's advice for dissolution — constitutional convention.
questions.revision_fact: Governor dissolves State Assembly on advice of Chief Minister under Article 174.

questions.question_hindi: एक समयुग्मजी प्रभावी लंबा पादप (TT) एक समयुग्मजी अप्रभावी बौने पौधे (tt) के साथ क्रॉस कराया जाता है। F₁ पीढ़ी के पौधों में स्व-निषेचन कराया जाता है, जिससे F₂ पीढ़ी उत्पन्न होती है। F₂ पीढ़ी में, समयुग्मजी प्रभावी (TT) व्यष्टियों और समयुग्मजी अप्रभावी (tt) व्यष्टियों का जीनप्ररूपी अनुपात क्या होगा?
questions.question_english: A homozygous dominant tall plant (TT) is crossed with a homozygous recessive dwarf plant (tt). The F₁ progeny are self-fertilized to produce the F₂ generation. In the F₂ generation, what is the genotypic ratio of homozygous dominant (TT) individuals to homozygous recessive (tt) individuals?
questions.technical_proof: F₁ = all Tt. F₁ × F₁ (Tt × Tt) → F₂: 1 TT : 2 Tt : 1 tt. So TT:tt = 1:1.
questions.explanation: F₂ genotypic ratio is 1 TT : 2 Tt : 1 tt. Therefore TT:tt = 1:1.
questions.trap_point: Students confuse phenotypic ratio (3:1 tall:dwarf) with genotypic ratio of TT:tt (1:1).
questions.memory_trick: F₂ genotypes = 1:2:1. TT and tt are each 1 → ratio 1:1.
questions.revision_fact: F₂ genotypic ratio of TT:Tt:tt = 1:2:1; TT:tt = 1:1.

questions.question_hindi: इनमें से कौन-सा कानूनी कदम, जिसे राजस्थान ने सबसे पहले लागू किया था, उसका मकसद शासन में पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही बढ़ाना था?
questions.question_english: Which of the following legislative measures, first enacted by Rajasthan, aimed at enhancing transparency and accountability in governance?

options.text: Rajasthan Transparency in Public Procurement Act, 2012

questions.technical_proof: Rajasthan was the first state in India to enact a Right to Information Act in 2000, years before the national RTI Act 2005. This was the pioneering transparency legislation.
questions.explanation: Rajasthan enacted the Right to Information Act in 2000 — the first state in India to do so, predating the national RTI Act 2005 by 5 years.
questions.trap_point: Students may pick the Public Service Guarantee Act, but the first transparency act was RTI 2000.
questions.memory_trick: Rajasthan RTI 2000 → First in India, 5 years before national RTI (2005).
questions.revision_fact: Rajasthan RTI Act 2000 was India's first RTI legislation — pioneer in transparency.

questions.question_hindi:
सूची-I (प्राकृतिक स्रोत) का सूची-II (अम्ल) के साथ मिलान करें:
(a) सिरका → (i) ऑक्जेलिक अम्ल
(b) नारंगी → (ii) एसीटिक अम्ल
(c) दही → (iii) साइट्रिक अम्ल
(d) टमाटर → (iv) लैक्टिक अम्ल
questions.question_english:
Match List-I (Natural source) with List-II (Acid):
(a) Vinegar → (i) Oxalic acid
(b) Orange → (ii) Acetic acid
(c) Curd → (iii) Citric acid
(d) Tomato → (iv) Lactic acid
questions.technical_proof: Vinegar → Acetic acid; Orange → Citric acid; Curd → Lactic acid; Tomato → Oxalic acid. So (a)-(ii), (b)-(iii), (c)-(iv), (d)-(i) = Option D.
questions.explanation: Vinegar=Acetic acid; Orange=Citric acid; Curd=Lactic acid; Tomato=Oxalic acid.
questions.trap_point: Students often confuse Tomato with Citric acid or Oxalic acid. Tomato contains Oxalic acid.
questions.memory_trick: VOCO: Vinegar=Acetic, Orange=Citric, Curd=Lactic, tOmato=Oxalic.
questions.revision_fact: Tomato → Oxalic acid; Orange → Citric acid; Curd → Lactic acid; Vinegar → Acetic acid.

questions.question_hindi: मोतीलाल तेजावत के नेतृत्व में 'एकी आंदोलन' के रूप में एक बड़े भील विद्रोह की शुरुआत क्यों की गई?
questions.question_english: Why was a major Bhil Uprising launched as Eki Movement under the leadership of Motilal Tejawat?

options.text: To integrate Bhils with intense colonial sympathy.
To initiate religious reforms among Bhils.
In support of British policies by Bhils.
To unite Bhils against states, feudal lords and British oppression.

questions.technical_proof: The Eki Movement (1921-22) under Motilal Tejawat was launched to unite the Bhil tribal community against the oppression of states, feudal lords (zamindars), and British colonial rule.
questions.explanation: The Eki Movement was an anti-exploitation movement to unite Bhils against the triple oppression of feudal lords, states and British rule.
questions.trap_point: Do not confuse with religious reform movements.
questions.memory_trick: Eki = Unity of Bhils against State + Feudal + British oppression.
questions.revision_fact: Eki Movement (1921-22): Motilal Tejawat led Bhils against feudal lords, states, and British oppression.

questions.question_hindi: 9 क्रमागत विषम संख्याओं का औसत, यदि उन संख्याओं में से सबसे छोटी संख्या को n द्वारा दर्शाया जाता है, है:
questions.question_english: The average of 9 consecutive odd numbers if the smallest of those numbers is denoted by n is:
questions.technical_proof: 9 consecutive odd numbers starting from n: n, n+2, n+4, n+6, n+8, n+10, n+12, n+14, n+16. Sum = 9n + (0+2+4+6+8+10+12+14+16) = 9n + 72. Average = (9n+72)/9 = n+8.
questions.explanation: Sum of 9 consecutive odd numbers starting at n = 9n + 72. Average = n + 8.
questions.trap_point: Students may use consecutive integers formula. Consecutive ODD numbers differ by 2, not 1.
questions.memory_trick: 9 terms, middle term = 5th = n+8 (since each step is +2). Average = middle term = n+8.
questions.revision_fact: Average of 9 consecutive odd numbers starting from n = n + 8 (the 5th/middle term).

questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित तत्वों को इलेक्ट्रॉनों की संख्या के आरोही क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें: (a) नियोन, (b) मैग्नीशियम, (c) पोटेशियम, (d) सल्फर
questions.question_english: Arrange the following elements in the ascending order of number of electrons: (a) Neon, (b) Magnesium, (c) Potassium, (d) Sulphur
questions.technical_proof: Atomic numbers (= electrons): Neon (Ne) = 10, Magnesium (Mg) = 12, Sulphur (S) = 16, Potassium (K) = 19. Ascending order: Ne(10) < Mg(12) < S(16) < K(19) = (a),(b),(d),(c) = Option B.
questions.explanation: Ne=10, Mg=12, S=16, K=19. Ascending: (a)Ne, (b)Mg, (d)S, (c)K.
questions.trap_point: Students may misremember Potassium's atomic number as lower than Sulphur.
questions.memory_trick: Ne(10), Mg(12), S(16), K(19) — memorise these atomic numbers.
questions.revision_fact: Neon=10, Magnesium=12, Sulphur=16, Potassium=19 electrons.

questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शहर सोरसन वन्यजीव अभयारण्य के सबसे निकट है?
questions.question_english: Which of the following city is closest to Sorsan Wildlife Sanctuary?
questions.technical_proof: Sorsan Wildlife Sanctuary (also known as Sorsan Grassland) is located in Baran district, Rajasthan. The nearest major city is Kota.
questions.explanation: Sorsan Wildlife Sanctuary is in Baran district near Kota, known for the Great Indian Bustard habitat.
questions.trap_point: Sorsan is in Baran, which is near Kota — not Jodhpur or Nagaur.
questions.memory_trick: Sorsan → Baran → near Kota.
questions.revision_fact: Sorsan Wildlife Sanctuary — Baran district, Rajasthan. Nearest city: Kota.

questions.question_hindi:
अभिकथन (A): राजस्थान सहकारी डेयरी महासंघ (आर. सी. डी. एफ.) के तहत 'सरस' ब्रांड त्रिस्तरीय संरचना का अनुसरण करता है।
कारण (R): त्रिस्तरीय सहकारी संरचना में शीर्ष पर जिला परिषद, उसके बाद पंचायत समिति और ग्राम पंचायत शामिल हैं।
questions.question_english:
Assertion (A): The 'Saras' brand under the Rajasthan Cooperative Dairy Federation (RCDF) follows a Three-Tier structure.
Reason (R): The Three-Tier Cooperative structure consists of the Zila Parishad at the top, followed by the Panchayat Samiti and the Gram Panchayat.

options.text: (A) is not correct but (R) is correct.
Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A).
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct.

questions.technical_proof: RCDF's Saras brand does follow a three-tier cooperative structure (A is correct). However, the three-tier dairy cooperative structure consists of: (1) Village Dairy Cooperative Society (primary level), (2) District Milk Union (district level), (3) State Cooperative Dairy Federation (apex/RCDF). The Reason (R) incorrectly describes the three-tier structure as Zila Parishad → Panchayat Samiti → Gram Panchayat, which is the PRIs structure, not dairy cooperatives. So R is incorrect.
questions.explanation: Assertion (A) is correct. Reason (R) is incorrect — it describes PRIs structure, not dairy cooperative structure.
questions.trap_point: R describes Panchayati Raj structure, not dairy cooperative structure.
questions.memory_trick: Dairy co-op tiers: Village Society → District Milk Union → State Federation (RCDF).
questions.revision_fact: RCDF three-tier: Village DCS → District Milk Union → RCDF (state apex). Not Zila Parishad/Panchayat.

questions.question_hindi: कर्सर के बाईं ओर के वर्णों को हटाने के लिए किस कुंजी (की) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.question_english: Which key is used to delete characters to the left of the cursor?
questions.technical_proof: Backspace key deletes the character to the LEFT of the cursor. Delete key removes the character to the RIGHT of the cursor.
questions.explanation: Backspace = deletes LEFT of cursor. Delete = deletes RIGHT of cursor.
questions.trap_point: Delete key deletes to the RIGHT, not left. Backspace is for left.
questions.memory_trick: Backspace = Back (left). Delete = Delete forward (right).
questions.revision_fact: Backspace → deletes character to the LEFT of cursor. Delete → deletes to the RIGHT.

questions.question_hindi: कौन-सा प्राधिकरण पंचायती राज संस्थानों के खातों का लेखा-परीक्षण करता है?
questions.question_english: Which authority audits the accounts of Panchayati Raj Institutions?
questions.technical_proof: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India audits the accounts of Panchayati Raj Institutions under Article 149 and the CAG's DPC Act. The State Election Commission conducts elections; the State Finance Commission recommends resource distribution.
questions.explanation: CAG of India audits accounts of PRIs. SFC recommends resource distribution; SEC conducts elections.
questions.trap_point: SFC and CAG are both related to PRIs but for different functions.
questions.memory_trick: CAG = Auditor. SFC = Finance recommender. SEC = Election holder.
questions.revision_fact: CAG of India audits PRI accounts. Article 149 empowers CAG to audit local bodies.

questions.question_hindi: 'भारत में हिम तेंदुओं की स्थिति रिपोर्ट' (2024) के अनुसार भारत के किस राज्य में हिम तेंदुओं की संख्या सबसे अधिक है?
questions.question_english: Which state in India hosts the highest number of snow leopards as per the 'status report of snow leopards in India' (2024)?
questions.technical_proof: As per the Snow Leopard Status Report 2024, Ladakh (UT) has the highest population of snow leopards in India, with an estimated 477-718 individuals.
questions.explanation: Ladakh holds the highest snow leopard population in India per the 2024 status report.
questions.trap_point: Students may think Himachal Pradesh has more, but Ladakh tops the count.
questions.memory_trick: Ladakh = Land of Snow Leopards — highest count.
questions.revision_fact: Snow Leopard Status Report 2024: Ladakh (UT) has the highest snow leopard population in India.

questions.question_hindi: कार्तिक मास में दीपदान की परंपरा और पशु मेला किसकी प्रमुख विशेषताएँ हैं?
questions.question_english: A tradition of deepdan in the Karthik month and an animal fair are the primary features of:
questions.technical_proof: Pushkar Fair (Pushkar Mela) held in Karthik month is famous for both the Deepdan tradition (floating lamps on Pushkar lake) and one of Asia's largest cattle/animal fairs.
questions.explanation: Pushkar Mela = Karthik month + Deepdan tradition + Animal fair. Held at Pushkar, Ajmer.
questions.trap_point: Multiple Rajasthan fairs have religious traditions but Pushkar specifically combines Deepdan + Animal fair in Karthik.
questions.memory_trick: Pushkar = Holy lake (Deepdan) + Camel/Cattle Fair = Karthik Mela.
questions.revision_fact: Pushkar Fair: Karthik month, Deepdan on Pushkar Lake, Asia's largest animal fair.

questions.question_hindi: 2024 के अंत में चर्चा में आई 'पीएम-विद्यालक्ष्मी' योजना मुख्य रूप से किसके लिए है?
questions.question_english: The 'PM-Vidyalaxmi' scheme, discussed in late 2024, is primarily intended for:

options.text: Financial support (loans) for meritorious students for higher education.

questions.technical_proof: PM Vidyalaxmi scheme launched in late 2024 provides collateral-free and guarantor-free education loans to meritorious students for higher education in top institutions.
questions.explanation: PM-Vidyalaxmi provides collateral-free education loans to meritorious students for higher education.
questions.trap_point: PM Vidyalaxmi sounds like a scholarship but it is actually a loan scheme.
questions.memory_trick: Vidyalaxmi = Vidya (education) + Lakshmi (financial support/loans).
questions.revision_fact: PM-Vidyalaxmi (2024): Collateral-free education loans for meritorious higher education students.

questions.question_english: Which of the following compounds has the lowest boiling point?

questions.question_hindi: किस मौलिक अधिकार को संविधान के हृदय और आत्मा के रूप में जाना जाता है?
questions.question_english: Which Fundamental Right is known as the heart and soul of the Constitution?
questions.technical_proof: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar called Article 32 (Right to Constitutional Remedies) the 'heart and soul of the Constitution.' It allows citizens to approach the Supreme Court for enforcement of fundamental rights.

questions.revision_fact: Article 32 (Right to Constitutional Remedies) = 'Heart and Soul of Constitution' — Dr. Ambedkar.

questions.question_english: What was the theme of the International Day of Yoga 2025?

questions.question_hindi:
राजस्थान के निम्नलिखित जलवायु क्षेत्रों को पूर्व से पश्चिम के क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए:
(a) आर्द्र जलवायु क्षेत्र, (b) बहुत आर्द्र जलवायु क्षेत्र, (c) शुष्क जलवायु क्षेत्र, (d) अर्ध-शुष्क जलवायु क्षेत्र
questions.question_english:
Arrange the following climatic regions of Rajasthan from east to west:
(a) Humid Climatic Region, (b) Very Humid Climatic Region, (c) Arid Climatic Region, (d) Semi Arid Climatic Region
questions.technical_proof: Rajasthan climate zones from East to West: Very Humid (eastern most, receives maximum monsoon) → Humid → Semi-Arid → Arid (western Thar Desert). So: (b) Very Humid → (a) Humid → (d) Semi-Arid → (c) Arid = Option D.
questions.explanation: East to West Rajasthan climate: Very Humid → Humid → Semi-Arid → Arid (Thar Desert).
questions.trap_point: Eastern Rajasthan is wetter (Very Humid), western is driest (Arid).
questions.memory_trick: East = More rain (Very Humid); West = No rain (Arid Thar).
questions.revision_fact: Rajasthan East→West climate: Very Humid → Humid → Semi-Arid → Arid.

questions.question_hindi: 16 श्रमिक दिन में 6 घंटे काम करते हैं, 25 दिनों में 150 m लंबाई, 20 m चौड़ाई और 2 m ऊँचाई की दीवार बनाते हैं। 12 श्रमिक, जो दिन में 8 घंटे काम करते हैं, 800 m लंबाई, 15 m चौड़ाई और 6 m ऊँचाई की दीवार कितने दिनों में बना सकते हैं?
questions.question_english: 16 workers working 6 hours a day, build a wall of length 150 m, breadth 20 m, and height 2 m in 25 days. In how many days 12 workers, working 8 hours a day can build a wall of length 800 m, breadth 15 m and height 6 m?
questions.technical_proof: Volume 1 = 150×20×2 = 6000 m³. Work done by 16 workers × 6 hrs × 25 days = 2400 worker-hours. Volume 2 = 800×15×6 = 72000 m³. Volume ratio = 72000/6000 = 12. Worker-hour ratio = (12×8×D)/(16×6×25). Setting proportional: D = 25 × 12 × (16×6)/(12×8) = 25×12×12/8 = 25×18 = 450. Re-check: Using MDH/V formula: M1×D1×H1/V1 = M2×D2×H2/V2 → 16×25×6/6000 = 12×D×8/72000 → 0.4 = 96D/72000 → D = 72000×0.4/96 = 28800/96 = 300. Answer should be 300 = Option B.
questions.explanation: Using M×D×H/V formula: (16×25×6)/6000 = (12×D×8)/72000. Solving: D = 300 days. Correct answer is B (300), not C.
questions.trap_point: Volume must be included in calculation. This is M1D1H1/V1 = M2D2H2/V2 type problem.
questions.memory_trick: MDH/V formula for wall construction problems.
questions.revision_fact: Wall problems: M1×D1×H1/V1 = M2×D2×H2/V2. Here answer = 300 days.
questions.review_status: 🚨 ANSWER KEY BUG DETECTED - Book says C(150) but calculation gives B(300)

questions.question_english: Which of the following river falls into the Arabian Sea?
questions.technical_proof: Mahi River flows through Rajasthan and Gujarat, draining into the Arabian Sea (Gulf of Khambhat). Chambal and Kali Sindh are tributaries of Yamuna (Bay of Bengal drainage). Banas joins Chambal.
questions.explanation: Mahi → Arabian Sea (Gulf of Khambhat). Chambal, Kali Sindh, Banas → ultimately Bay of Bengal via Yamuna-Ganga.
questions.trap_point: Most Rajasthan rivers drain into Bay of Bengal. Mahi is an exception going to Arabian Sea.
questions.memory_trick: Mahi = flows West = Arabian Sea. Chambal = flows North/East = Bay of Bengal.
questions.revision_fact: Mahi River drains into the Arabian Sea. It is the only major river in Rajasthan that flows into the Arabian Sea.

questions.question_hindi: राजस्थान के निम्नलिखित में से किस केंद्रीय रूप से संरक्षित टिकट वाले स्मारक में वर्ष 2024-25 में सर्वाधिक घरेलू पर्यटक आए?
questions.question_english: Which of the following Centrally Protected Ticketed Monuments of Rajasthan received the largest domestic tourists in 2024-25?
questions.technical_proof: Kumbhalgarh Fort is among the most visited monuments in Rajasthan. However, Chittorgarh Fort typically receives very high visitors too. Answer needs official data confirmation.

questions.question_hindi:
'पीएम-जनमन' मिशन के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
(a) इसका उद्देश्य विशेष रूप से कमजोर जनजातीय समूहों (पी.वी.टी.जी.) का विकास करना है।
(b) इसमें आवास, स्वच्छ जल और सड़क संपर्क जैसे 11 महत्वपूर्ण कार्य शामिल हैं।
(c) इस मिशन का बजट 24,000 करोड़ रुपये से अधिक है।
(d) यह विशेष रूप से पूर्वोत्तर भारत में जनजातीय आबादी के लिए है।
questions.question_english:
Which of the following statements are correct about 'PM-JANMAN' Mission?
(a) It is aimed at the development of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs).
(b) It covers 11 critical interventions like housing, clean water, and road connectivity.
(c) The mission has a budget of over ₹24,000 crore.
(d) It is exclusively for tribal populations in North-Eastern India.
questions.technical_proof: PM-JANMAN: (a) True — targets PVTGs; (b) True — 11 critical interventions; (c) True — budget ~₹24,000 crore; (d) False — it covers PVTGs across India, not exclusively Northeast.
questions.explanation: PM-JANMAN targets PVTGs across India with 11 interventions and ₹24,000 crore budget. Statement (d) is false.
questions.trap_point: PM-JANMAN is for ALL PVTGs in India, not just Northeast tribes.
questions.memory_trick: PM-JANMAN = PVTGs + 11 interventions + ₹24,000 cr. Pan-India, not just NE.

questions.question_hindi: ओलंपिक (पेरिस 2024) के एकल संस्करण में दो ओलंपिक पदक जीतने वाली पहली भारतीय महिला कौन बनीं?

questions.technical_proof: Manu Bhaker won two bronze medals at Paris Olympics 2024 — in 10m air pistol (individual) and 10m air pistol mixed team (with Sarabjot Singh). She became the first Indian woman (and first Indian since Independence) to win two medals at a single Olympics.
questions.explanation: Manu Bhaker won 2 bronze medals at Paris 2024 Olympics — first Indian to do so in a single edition since Independence.
questions.trap_point: Vinesh Phogat was disqualified; Manu Bhaker won 2 medals.

questions.question_hindi:
उत्तरी अरावली पर्वत की चोटियों की पहचान कीजिए:
(a) रघुनाथगढ़ चोटी, (b) गुरु शिखर, (c) भैरच चोटी, (d) खो चोटी
questions.question_english:
Identify the peaks of North Aravalli Mountain:
(a) Raghunathgarh Peak, (b) Guru Shikhar, (c) Bhairach Peak, (d) Kho Peak
questions.technical_proof: Guru Shikhar (1722 m) is the highest peak of the Aravalli range, located in the SOUTHERN Aravalli (Mt. Abu, Sirohi). Raghunathgarh, Bhairach (Bhairavgarh), and Kho are peaks in the NORTHERN Aravalli range (Sikar/Jaipur region).
questions.explanation: North Aravalli peaks: Raghunathgarh, Bhairach, Kho. Guru Shikhar is in South Aravalli (Mt. Abu). So (a), (c), (d) = Option C.
questions.trap_point: Guru Shikhar is the highest peak overall but belongs to SOUTHERN Aravalli, not Northern.
questions.memory_trick: Guru Shikhar = South (Mt. Abu, Sirohi). Raghunathgarh/Bhairach/Kho = North Aravalli.
questions.revision_fact: Guru Shikhar = Highest Aravalli peak (1722m) = Southern Aravalli (Mt. Abu). North peaks: Raghunathgarh, Bhairach, Kho.

questions.question_hindi: गोलू और बोलू की गतियों का अनुपात 4 : 7 है। यदि गोलू 270 m से दौड़ हार जाता है, तो धावन-पथ (रेस-कोर्स) की लंबाई क्या है?
questions.question_english: The ratio of speeds of Golu and Bolu is 4 : 7. If Golu loses the race by 270 m, then what is the length of the race course?
questions.technical_proof: Speed ratio = 4:7. When Bolu finishes the race (length L), Golu has covered (4/7)×L. Golu loses by 270 m means Bolu is ahead by 270 m when Bolu finishes. So L - (4L/7) = 270 → 3L/7 = 270 → L = 630 m. Option C is correct.
questions.trap_point: Losing 'by 270 m' means the winner is 270 m ahead when he finishes.
questions.memory_trick: Difference in distances covered = ratio difference × L / total ratio. (7-4)/7 × L = 270 → L=630.
questions.revision_fact: Race formula: If speeds ratio = a:b, loser is behind by L×(b-a)/b when winner finishes.

questions.question_hindi: मनुष्यों में वृक्क निम्नलिखित तंत्र का एक भाग है:
questions.question_english: The kidneys in human beings are a part of the system for:
questions.technical_proof: Kidneys are the primary organs of the excretory system (urinary system). They filter blood and excrete waste as urine.
questions.explanation: Kidneys = part of Excretory System (Urinary System). They remove urea, excess water, salts from blood.
questions.trap_point: Students should not confuse kidneys with circulatory (transport) system.
questions.memory_trick: K for Kidneys = K for excretion (waste Kicked out).
questions.revision_fact: Kidneys → Excretory System. Liver also aids excretion but kidneys are primary.

questions.question_hindi: मेवाड़ के किस शासक को 32 किलों के निर्माण और 'संगीतराज' की रचना के लिए जाना जाता है, और जिनके बारे में यह भी माना जाता है कि उन्होंने 'गीत गोविंद' पर एक टीका लिखी थी?
questions.question_english: Which ruler of Mewar is celebrated for building 32 forts, for writing Sangitaraj and believed to have written a commentary on Gita Govinda?
questions.technical_proof: Maharana Kumbha (1433-1468 CE) of Mewar built 32 forts out of 84 in Rajasthan. He wrote 'Sangitaraj' (musicology treatise) and 'Rasikpriya' (commentary on Gita Govinda by Jayadeva). He was also a great warrior and patron of arts.
questions.explanation: Maharana Kumbha: 32 forts builder, wrote Sangitaraj, wrote commentary on Gita Govinda.
questions.trap_point: Rana Sanga was a great warrior but not known for music or fort building on this scale.
questions.memory_trick: Kumbha = Kumbhalgarh + Sangitaraj + 32 Forts = Great builder-king of Mewar.
questions.revision_fact: Maharana Kumbha: 32 forts, Sangitaraj, Gita Govinda commentary, Kumbhalgarh Fort.

questions.question_hindi: दूसरे वर्ष और तीसरे वर्ष के लिए ब्याज की एक निश्चित दर पर एक निश्चित राशि पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज क्रमशः ₹21,780 और ₹23,958 हैं। ब्याज की दर क्या है?
questions.question_english: The compound interest on a certain sum at a certain rate of interest for the second year and third year is ₹21,780 and ₹23,958, respectively. What is the rate of interest?
questions.trap_point: Direct ratio of consecutive year CIs gives (1+r). Students may try other approaches.
questions.memory_trick: CI ratio of consecutive years = (1 + r). 23958/21780 = 1.1 = r=10%.
questions.revision_fact: CI for consecutive years ratio = (1 + r/100). Use this to find rate directly.

questions.question_hindi: राजस्थान की राज्य आय (सकल राज्य घरेलू उत्पाद) का आधिकारिक अनुमान और प्रकाशन निम्नलिखित में से किस संस्था द्वारा किया जाता है?

Economic and Statistical Organisation under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

questions.explanation: DES Rajasthan publishes official GSDP data for the state, similar to how CSO/MoSPI does for national GDP.
questions.trap_point: CSO/MOSPI handles national GDP; state-level GSDP is handled by state DES.
questions.memory_trick: GSDP of Rajasthan → DES (Directorate of Economics & Statistics), Rajasthan Govt.
questions.revision_fact: Rajasthan GSDP is officially published by Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Govt. of Rajasthan.

questions.question_hindi: राजस्थान के पारंपरिक 'मांड' लोक संगीत में योगदान के लिए 2024 में 'पद्म श्री' किसे प्राप्त हुआ?
questions.question_english: Who received the 'Padma Shri' in 2024 for contribution to traditional 'Maand' folk music of Rajasthan?

questions.revision_fact: Maand folk music Padma Shri 2024 winners: Ali Mohammad and Gani Mohammad.

questions.question_hindi: पादपों में कार्बोहाइड्रेट संग्रहीत होता है:
questions.question_english: Carbohydrates in plants are stored in the form of:
questions.technical_proof: Plants store carbohydrates as Starch (in chloroplasts and amyloplasts). Animals store carbohydrates as Glycogen (in liver and muscles).
questions.explanation: Plants → Starch storage. Animals → Glycogen storage. Glucose is the transport form. Maltose is a disaccharide formed during digestion of starch.
questions.trap_point: Glycogen is the animal storage form, not plants. Plants use Starch.
questions.memory_trick: Plants = S for Starch. Animals = G for Glycogen.
questions.revision_fact: Plants store carbohydrates as STARCH. Animals store as GLYCOGEN.

questions.question_hindi:
सूची-I (स्थानीय निकाय) का सूची-II (प्रमुख) के साथ मिलान कीजिए:
(a) ग्राम पंचायत → (i) सरपंच
(b) पंचायत समिति → (ii) प्रधान

questions.question_english:
Match List-I (Local Body) with List-II (Head):
(a) Gram Panchayat → (i) Sarpanch
(b) Panchayat Samiti → (ii) Pradhan
(c) Zila Parishad → (iii) Mayor/Chairman

questions.technical_proof: Gram Panchayat = Sarpanch; Panchayat Samiti = Pradhan; Zila Parishad = Pramukh; Municipal Corporation = Mayor. So (a)-(i), (b)-(ii), (c)-(iv), (d)-(iii) = Option C.

questions.question_hindi:
निम्नलिखित में से उन श्रेणियों को पहचानिए जिनमें राजस्थान में लोक संगीत को विभाजित किया गया है:

questions.question_english:
Identify from the following the categories in which Folk Music is divided in Rajasthan:
(a) Songs which evolved in feudal environment.

(c) Canonical classical music.

questions.explanation: Rajasthan folk music categories: (a) feudal environment songs, (b) regional feature songs, (d) occasion-based songs. Classical music (c) is not folk.
questions.trap_point: Classical music (c) is excluded from folk music classification.
questions.memory_trick: Folk = Feudal + Regional + Occasional. NOT Classical.
questions.revision_fact: Rajasthan folk music: 3 categories — feudal environment songs, regional feature songs, and occasion-based songs.

questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दी गई सूची में अलैंगिक विधि से प्रजनन करने वाले जीव हैं:
(a) केला, (b) कुत्ता, (c) यीस्ट, (d) अमीबा
questions.question_english:
In the list of organisms given below, those that reproduced by the asexual method are:
(a) Banana, (b) Dog, (c) Yeast, (d) Amoeba
questions.technical_proof: Banana reproduces asexually (vegetative propagation via suckers/rhizomes). Yeast reproduces asexually by budding. Amoeba reproduces asexually by binary fission. Dog reproduces sexually (sexual reproduction). So (a), (c), (d) = Option B.
questions.explanation: Asexual: Banana (vegetative), Yeast (budding), Amoeba (binary fission). Dog = sexual reproduction.
questions.trap_point: Banana does reproduce asexually in nature via suckers — sexual reproduction produces seeds but plants in crops are propagated asexually.
questions.memory_trick: BYA = Banana, Yeast, Amoeba = Asexual. Dogs = Sexual.
questions.revision_fact: Asexual reproducers: Banana (vegetative), Yeast (budding), Amoeba (binary fission).

questions.question_hindi: कौन-सा निकाय किसी राज्य में पंचायतों को वित्तीय वितरण की सिफारिश करता है?
questions.question_english: Which body recommends financial distribution to Panchayats in a state?
questions.technical_proof: State Finance Commission (SFC) recommends financial distribution between State and Panchayats as per Articles 243-I and 243-Y of the Constitution.
questions.explanation: SFC = State Finance Commission recommends finance to Panchayats/ULBs from the State. Finance Commission recommends Centre-State distribution.
questions.trap_point: Finance Commission is for Centre-State; SFC is for State-Panchayat.
questions.memory_trick: SFC = State + Panchayat level. Finance Commission = Centre + State level.
questions.revision_fact: State Finance Commission recommends financial devolution to Panchayats (Art. 243-I).

questions.question_hindi: राजस्थान में मवेशियों की किस नस्ल को अपनी उच्च दूध उत्पादन क्षमता के कारण 'राजस्थान के कामधेनु' के रूप में जाना जाता है?
questions.question_english: Which breed of cattle in Rajasthan is popularly known as the 'Kamdhenu of Rajasthan' due to its high milk-yielding capacity?
questions.technical_proof: Rathi breed of cattle, found primarily in Bikaner, Ganganagar, and Hanumangarh districts of Rajasthan, is known as the 'Kamdhenu of Rajasthan' due to its high milk production capacity.
questions.explanation: Rathi cattle = 'Kamdhenu of Rajasthan' = high milk yield = Bikaner/Ganganagar region.
questions.trap_point: Tharparkar is also a good milk breed but Rathi is specifically called 'Kamdhenu of Rajasthan'.
questions.memory_trick: Rathi = Rajasthan's Kamdhenu = High milk breed from north Rajasthan.
questions.revision_fact: Rathi breed = 'Kamdhenu of Rajasthan'; best milk-yielding cattle breed of Rajasthan.

questions.question_hindi: राजस्थान के प्रसिद्ध पुरातत्वविद् का नाम बताइए जिन्होंने प्रसिद्ध 'लिपिमाला' लिखी थी?
questions.question_english: Name the famous archaeologist of Rajasthan who wrote the famous 'Lipimala':
questions.technical_proof: Gaurishankar Heerachand Ojha (1863-1947) was a renowned historian and archaeologist of Rajasthan who wrote 'Lipimala' — a study of ancient scripts of India. He is considered the father of Rajasthan history.
questions.explanation: G.H. Ojha wrote 'Lipimala' — a foundational work on ancient Indian scripts. He is called the 'father of Rajasthan history'.
questions.trap_point: Ojha was both archaeologist and historian — known for Lipimala and Rajputana history.
questions.memory_trick: Ojha = Father of Rajasthan History = Lipimala (ancient scripts).
questions.revision_fact: Gaurishankar Heerachand Ojha: wrote Lipimala; Father of Rajasthan History.

questions.question_hindi: हाइड्रोक्लोरिक अम्ल से आमाशय की भीतरी परत की सुरक्षा निम्नलिखित में से एक द्वारा की जाती है। सही की पहचान करें।
questions.question_english: The inner lining of stomach is protected by one of the following from hydrochloric acid. Identify the correct one.
questions.technical_proof: The inner lining of the stomach (gastric mucosa) is protected from HCl by a thick layer of mucus secreted by goblet cells in the stomach wall.
questions.explanation: Mucus secreted by stomach lining protects it from HCl damage. Without mucus → ulcers form.
questions.trap_point: Pepsin is an enzyme in stomach but it doesn't protect; Bile is in small intestine.
questions.memory_trick: Mucus = protective coat. Like a raincoat against HCl acid rain.
questions.revision_fact: Stomach inner lining protected by MUCUS from HCl. Ulcers occur when mucus layer breaks down.

questions.technical_proof: HCF of fractions = HCF of numerators / LCM of denominators. Numerators: 4, 4, 2, 36. HCF(4,4,2,36)=2. Denominators: 3, 9, 15, 21. LCM(3,9,15,21)=315. HCF = 2/315.
questions.explanation: HCF of fractions = HCF(numerators)/LCM(denominators) = 2/315.
questions.trap_point: Students confuse HCF of fractions with LCM of fractions formula.
questions.memory_trick: HCF of fractions: H over L → HCF of tops / LCM of bottoms.
questions.revision_fact: HCF of fractions = HCF of numerators ÷ LCM of denominators.

questions.question_hindi:
अभिकथन (A): भारत ने क्वांटम कंप्यूटिंग क्षमताओं को विकसित करने के लिए 'राष्ट्रीय क्वांटम मिशन' (NQM) शुरू किया है।
कारण (R): क्वांटम कंप्यूटर 'क्यूबिट्स' का उपयोग करते हैं, जो उन्हें क्लासिकल कंप्यूटरों की तुलना में कहीं अधिक तेजी से जटिल गणनाएँ करने में सक्षम बनाते हैं।
questions.question_english:
Assertion (A): India has launched the 'National Quantum Mission' (NQM) to develop quantum computing capabilities.
Reason (R): Quantum computers use 'Qubits' which allow them to perform complex calculations much faster than classical computers.

options.text: (A) is not correct but (R) is correct.
Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A).
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct.

questions.technical_proof: Both A and R are correct. NQM was approved by India in 2023. R correctly explains why quantum computers (using Qubits) are being developed — they vastly outperform classical computers for complex calculations. R is the correct explanation of A.
questions.explanation: A: NQM launched by India (2023) — True. R: Qubits enable faster complex calculations than classical computers — True and explains A.
questions.trap_point: Both statements are true here AND R does explain A — so B is correct.
questions.memory_trick: NQM → India's quantum mission → Qubits power quantum computing.
questions.revision_fact: National Quantum Mission (2023): India's initiative to develop quantum computing using Qubits.

questions.question_hindi:
चंबल नदी पर निर्मित निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से बांध/बैराज राजस्थान में स्थित हैं?
(a) राणा प्रताप सागर बांध, (b) कोटा बैराज, (c) जवाहर सागर बांध, (d) गांधी सागर बांध
questions.question_english:
Which of the following dams/barrages built on Chambal River are located in Rajasthan?
(a) Rana Pratap Sagar Dam, (b) Kota Barrage, (c) Jawahar Sagar Dam, (d) Gandhi Sagar Dam
questions.technical_proof: Gandhi Sagar Dam is in Madhya Pradesh. Rana Pratap Sagar Dam, Kota Barrage, and Jawahar Sagar Dam are all in Rajasthan on the Chambal River.
questions.explanation: Chambal dams in Rajasthan: Rana Pratap Sagar (Rawatbhata), Kota Barrage (Kota), Jawahar Sagar (Kota). Gandhi Sagar Dam is in MP.
questions.trap_point: Gandhi Sagar Dam is in MP, not Rajasthan — common mistake.
questions.memory_trick: Gandhi Sagar = MP (Mandsaur). Other three Chambal dams = Rajasthan.
questions.revision_fact: Chambal River dams in Rajasthan: Rana Pratap Sagar, Jawahar Sagar, Kota Barrage. Gandhi Sagar = MP.

questions.question_hindi: अमित भूषण से तीन गुना कुशल है। यदि अमित को एक काम पूरा करने में 6 दिन लगते हैं, तो भूषण उसी काम को कितने दिनों में पूरा करेगा?
questions.question_english: Amit is thrice as efficient as Bhushan. If Amit takes 6 days to complete a job, then in how many days will Bhushan complete the same job?
questions.technical_proof: Amit is 3× more efficient than Bhushan. If Amit takes 6 days, Bhushan takes 6×3 = 18 days.
questions.explanation: Efficiency ratio Amit:Bhushan = 3:1. Time ratio = 1:3. Bhushan's time = 6×3 = 18 days.
questions.trap_point: More efficient = less time. 3× efficient = 1/3 the time. Bhushan = 3× Amit's time.
questions.memory_trick: Efficiency ↑ 3× → Time ↓ 3×. Bhushan = 3× more time = 18 days.
questions.revision_fact: Efficiency and time are inversely proportional. 3× efficient → 1/3 time.

questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा खनिज तेल भंडार राजस्थान में स्थित है?
questions.question_english: Which of the following is a mineral oil reservoir situated in Rajasthan?
questions.technical_proof: Gudamalani is an oil field located in Barmer district of Rajasthan. Bassein is offshore Mumbai (Maharashtra), Naharkatiya is in Assam, Ankleshwar is in Gujarat.
questions.explanation: Gudamalani oil field — Barmer, Rajasthan. Other options are from Maharashtra, Assam, Gujarat.
questions.trap_count: Students may confuse Rajasthan oil fields with those in Gujarat or Assam.
questions.memory_trick: Gudamalani = Barmer = Rajasthan oil. Barmer is Rajasthan's oil capital.
questions.revision_fact: Rajasthan oil fields: Gudamalani, Mangala, Bhagyam, Aishwarya (all in Barmer basin).

questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प 'विकसित भारत @ 2047' पहल का मुख्य उद्देश्य है?
questions.question_english: Which of the following is the primary objective of the 'Viksit Bharat @ 2047' initiative?

options.text: Reduce income inequality across all regions of the country
Establish India as a global leader in digital and technological innovation.
Transform India into a fully developed nation.
Achieve self-sufficiency in agricultural production and exports

questions.technical_proof: 'Viksit Bharat @ 2047' is India's vision to become a fully developed (Viksit) nation by 2047, the centenary of independence. The primary objective is transforming India into a developed nation.
questions.explanation: Viksit Bharat 2047 = India becoming a 'Developed Nation' by its 100th independence year (2047).
questions.trap_point: The primary goal is 'developed nation' status, not specifically digital leadership or agriculture.
questions.memory_trick: Viksit = Developed. 2047 = 100 years of Independence. Primary goal = Developed India.
questions.revision_fact: Viksit Bharat @ 2047: India's vision to become a fully developed nation by its centenary of independence.

questions.question_hindi: मेवाड़ी बोली की साहित्यिक रचनाएँ राजस्थानी भाषा की किस प्रमुख बोली की साहित्यिक समृद्धि के तुलनीय हैं?
questions.question_english: The literary works of Mewari dialect are comparable in richness to which prominent dialect of Rajasthani language?
questions.technical_proof: Mewari and Marwari are the two most literarily rich dialects of Rajasthani language. Marwari has the most extensive literary tradition and Mewari is comparable to it.
questions.explanation: Mewari literary richness is comparable to Marwari dialect, the most prominent Rajasthani dialect.
questions.trap_point: Marwari is the most prominent overall; Mewari is comparable to it specifically in literary richness.
questions.memory_trick: Mewari (Udaipur) ≈ Marwari (Jodhpur) in literary richness. Two major literary dialects of Rajasthani.
questions.revision_fact: Mewari dialect literary works are comparable to Marwari dialect in richness.

questions.question_hindi: तान्या का वेतन रीमा की तुलना में 33.33% अधिक है। रीमा का वेतन तान्या के वेतन से कितना प्रतिशत कम है?
questions.question_english: Tanya's salary is 33.33% more than that of Reema. By how much percent is Reema's salary less than that of Tanya's?
questions.technical_proof: If Reema's salary = 100, Tanya's = 133.33. Reema is less than Tanya by (33.33/133.33)×100 = 25%.
questions.explanation: If A is x% more than B, then B is less than A by [x/(100+x)]×100 percent. Here x=33.33: 33.33/133.33×100 = 25%.
questions.trap_point: 33.33% more does NOT mean 33.33% less the other way. It's 25% less.
questions.memory_trick: A is 1/3 more than B → B is 1/4 (25%) less than A. This is the classic 1/3 ↔ 1/4 pair.
questions.revision_fact: If A is 33.33% more than B, then B is 25% less than A.

questions.question_hindi:
सूची-I (प्रेक्षण) का सूची-II (घटना) के साथ मिलान करें:
(a) साफ आसमान का नीला रंग → (i) अपवर्तन
(b) इंद्रधनुष का निर्माण → (ii) परावर्तन
(c) तारों का टिमटिमाना → (iii) प्रकीर्णन
(d) दर्पण में अपना प्रतिबिंब देखना → (iv) परिक्षेपण
questions.question_english:
Match List-I (Observation) with List-II (Phenomenon):
(a) Blue color of the clear sky → (i) Refraction
(b) Formation of a rainbow → (ii) Reflection
(c) Twinkling of stars → (iii) Scattering
(d) Seeing your image in a mirror → (iv) Dispersion
questions.technical_proof: Blue sky = Scattering (Rayleigh scattering); Rainbow = Dispersion (separation of white light into spectrum); Star twinkling = Refraction (atmospheric refraction); Mirror image = Reflection. So: (a)-(iii), (b)-(iv), (c)-(i), (d)-(ii) = Option B.
questions.explanation: Blue sky=Scattering; Rainbow=Dispersion; Star twinkle=Refraction; Mirror=Reflection. Option B.
questions.trap_point: Rainbow involves both refraction AND dispersion, but dispersion is the primary phenomenon.
questions.memory_trick: Sky=Scatter Blue; Rainbow=Disperse colors; Stars=Refract in atmosphere; Mirror=Reflect.
questions.revision_fact: Blue sky=Scattering; Rainbow=Dispersion; Twinkling stars=Refraction; Mirror image=Reflection.

questions.question_hindi: 2011 की जनगणना के अनुसार राजस्थान की साक्षरता दर क्या थी?
questions.question_english: What was the literacy rate of Rajasthan, according to the 2011 Census?
questions.technical_proof: As per 2011 Census, Rajasthan's literacy rate was 66.11% (approximately 67%). However the paper marks 70%. The official 2011 census literacy rate for Rajasthan is 66.11%. This may be a question error.
questions.explanation: Rajasthan literacy rate per 2011 Census = 66.11% ≈ 67%. The paper answer of 70% appears incorrect. Correct answer should be C (67%).
questions.trap_point: Exact figure from 2011 census is 66.11% — nearest option is 67%.
questions.memory_trick: Rajasthan literacy 2011 ≈ 66% (below national average of 74%).
questions.revision_fact: Rajasthan Literacy Rate (2011 Census) = 66.11%. National average = 74.04%.
questions.review_status: 🚨 ANSWER KEY BUG DETECTED - Book answer D=70% but correct answer is C=67% (actual: 66.11%)

questions.question_hindi:
राजस्थान के पश्चिमी भाग में मौजूदा सूखे की स्थिति के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कारक मुख्य रूप से जिम्मेदार हैं?
(a) अरावली पर्वत की स्थिति भारतीय मानसून की अरब सागर शाखा के समानांतर है।
(b) अरावली पर्वत की स्थिति भारतीय मानसून की बंगाल की खाड़ी शाखा के समानांतर है।
(c) अरावली पर्वत की कम ऊँचाई और वनस्पति की कमी।
(d) अरब सागर मानसून शाखा में बंगाल की खाड़ी मानसून शाखा की तुलना में नमी की मात्रा कम होना।
questions.question_english:
Which of the following factors are mainly responsible for prevailing drought conditions in Western Part of Rajasthan?
(a) Position of Aravalli Mountain parallel of Arabian Sea branch of Indian Monsoon.
(b) Position of Aravalli Mountain parallel of Bay of Bengal branch of Indian Monsoon.
(c) Lesser height of Aravalli Mountain and Lack of vegetation
(d) Low moisture content in Arabian Sea monsoon branch than Bay of Bengal monsoon branch.
questions.technical_proof: Western Rajasthan drought: (a) Aravalli runs parallel to Arabian Sea monsoon branch so monsoon passes without giving rain; (c) Aravalli's low height and lack of vegetation don't force moisture to rise; (d) Arabian Sea branch has less moisture than Bay of Bengal. Statement (b) is incorrect — the Bay of Bengal branch loses moisture before reaching Rajasthan.
questions.explanation: Factors (a), (c), (d) cause western Rajasthan drought. Aravalli runs parallel to Arabian Sea monsoon = no orographic rainfall.
questions.trap_point: Aravalli runs parallel to Arabian Sea monsoon (a), not perpendicular, so monsoon doesn't rise and rain.
questions.memory_trick: Aravalli parallel to monsoon = rain doesn't drop. Low height + dry Arabian Sea branch = Thar Desert.
questions.revision_fact: Western Rajasthan drought: Aravalli parallel to Arabian Sea monsoon; lesser height; dry Arabian Sea branch.

questions.question_hindi: राजस्थान बजट 2026-27 में घोषित 'मुख्यमंत्री लखपति दीदी योजना' के तहत संशोधित ऋण सीमा क्या है?

questions.explanation: Mukhyamantri Lakhpati Didi Yojana (Rajasthan 2026-27): Revised loan limit = ₹1.5 lakh per paper answer.
questions.trap_point: Recent budget announcement — must keep track of latest revisions.
questions.memory_trick: Lakhpati Didi loan limit revised upward in 2026-27 budget.
questions.revision_fact: Mukhyamantri Lakhpati Didi Yojana (Rajasthan): Revised loan limit ₹1.5 lakh in Budget 2026-27.
questions.review_status: Needs Verification - Requires Rajasthan Budget 2026-27 document

questions.question_hindi:
उपर्युक्त पाई-चार्ट विभिन्न समूहों में छात्रों की संख्या को दर्शाता है। छात्रों की कुल संख्या 1200 है और लड़कियों तथा लड़कों का अनुपात 2:1 है। यदि 30% लड़कियाँ D समूह में हैं तो समूह D में लड़कों और लड़कियों का अनुपात है:
(D group = 35% of total)
questions.question_english:
The above pie-chart shows the number of students in different groups. The total number of students is 1200 and the ratio of girls to boys is 2:1. If 30% of girls are in D, then the ratio of boys to girls in group D is:
(D group = 35% of total)
questions.technical_proof: Total = 1200. Girls:Boys = 2:1, so Girls = 800, Boys = 400. D group = 35% of 1200 = 420. Girls in D = 30% of 800 = 240. Boys in D = 420 - 240 = 180. Ratio Boys:Girls in D = 180:240 = 3:4. Wait - options show Boys:Girls. 180:240 = 3:4 = Option D. But the question asks ratio of Boys to Girls in D. Let me recheck: The question asks 'ratio of boys to girls' in group D. 180:240 = 3:4 = Option D, not B. Paper marks B (1:2). Need to recheck girls proportion.
questions.explanation: Girls=800, Boys=400. D=420 students. Girls in D=240. Boys in D=180. Boys:Girls = 180:240 = 3:4.
questions.trap_point: Check if the question asks Boys:Girls or Girls:Boys ratio.
questions.memory_trick: Always identify which ratio is asked — Boys:Girls vs Girls:Boys.
questions.revision_fact: DI pie chart: compute absolute numbers first, then find ratios.
questions.review_status: Needs Review - Calculation gives 3:4 (D) but paper shows B (1:2)

questions.question_hindi: ऊपर दिया गया ग्राफ कंपनियों A, B, C और D के आयात और निर्यात मूल्यों को करोड़ों में दर्शाता है। कंपनी A और C के कुल निर्यात का, कंपनी A और C के कुल आयात से क्या अनुपात है?
questions.question_english: The above graph represents the import and export values in crores of A, B, C and D companies. What is the ratio of exports of A and C together to the imports of A and C together?
questions.technical_proof: From graph: A exports=10, A imports=15. C exports=5, C imports=12.5 (approx). Total exports(A+C)=15; Total imports(A+C)=27.5. Ratio=15:27.5=30:55=6:11. Does not match options. Reading from graph more carefully needed. Paper marks C (5:7).
questions.explanation: Export ratio A+C to import A+C per paper = 5:7. Values need to be precisely read from the graph.
questions.trap_point: Graph reading must be precise. Approximate values lead to wrong ratio.
questions.memory_trick: DI graph: Always read values carefully before computing ratios.
questions.revision_fact: Always sum the relevant values from graph before computing ratios in DI questions.
