questions.question_hindi: जब मैग्नीशियम रिबन को हवा में जलाया जाता है, तो निर्मित राख का रंग होता है:
questions.question_english: When a magnesium ribbon is burnt in air, the color of ash that is formed is:
questions.technical_proof: When magnesium ribbon burns in air: 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO (Magnesium oxide). MgO is a white powder. The ash (residue) is white coloured MgO.
questions.explanation: Mg + O₂ → MgO (white powder/ash). Magnesium burns with bright white flame and leaves white ash.
questions.trap_point: The flame is bright white, and the ash is also white — both are white.
questions.memory_trick: Mg burns → White flame → White ash (MgO). Everything white with Magnesium.
questions.revision_fact: Magnesium burns in air → Magnesium Oxide (MgO) = White ash.

questions.question_hindi: राजस्थान के मुख्यमंत्री के रूप में सबसे लंबे कार्यकाल का रिकॉर्ड किसके नाम है?
questions.question_english: Who holds the record for the longest tenure as Chief Minister of Rajasthan?
questions.technical_proof: Mohan Lal Sukhadia served as Chief Minister of Rajasthan for about 17 years (1954-1971) — the longest tenure by any CM of Rajasthan. He is called the 'Builder of Modern Rajasthan'.
questions.explanation: Mohan Lal Sukhadia = Longest serving CM of Rajasthan = 17 years (1954-1971).
questions.trap_point: Ashok Gehlot also served 3 terms but total duration is less than Sukhadia's 17 years.
questions.memory_trick: Sukhadia = Sab se Zyada = Longest = 17 years = Builder of Modern Rajasthan.
questions.revision_fact: Mohan Lal Sukhadia: Longest serving CM of Rajasthan (1954-1971, ~17 years). Called 'Builder of Modern Rajasthan'.

questions.question_hindi: राजस्थान में कई प्रकार के 'लहरिया' लोकप्रिय हैं। जब पट्टियाँ एक-दूसरे को क्रॉस करती हैं तो उस डिज़ाइन पैटर्न को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.question_english: Many types of 'Lahariyas' are popular in Rajasthan. What is the design pattern called when strips criss-cross each other?
questions.technical_proof: Mothara Lahariya (also called Mothda) is the pattern where the diagonal stripes criss-cross each other, creating a checkerboard-like diagonal pattern. Simple Lahariya has parallel diagonal stripes.
questions.explanation: Mothara Lahariya = criss-cross pattern (diagonal stripes crossing each other). Simple Lahariya = parallel diagonal stripes.
questions.trap_point: Simple Lahariya = parallel stripes; Mothara Lahariya = criss-cross stripes.
questions.memory_trick: Mothara = Motherboard-like criss-cross pattern. Lahariya = waves.
questions.revision_fact: Mothara Lahariya = criss-cross diagonal stripe pattern. Major Rajasthani textile tradition.

questions.question_hindi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कारक राजस्थान में कम बाल लिंग अनुपात के लिए सीधे तौर पर जिम्मेदार नहीं है?
(a) बाल विवाह के कारण मातृ मृत्यु हुई
(b) पितृसत्तात्मक समाज
(c) प्रसव पूर्व लिंग निधारण के संपर्क में आना
(d) दहेज प्रणाली
questions.question_english:
Which of the following factor is not directly responsible for low child sex ratio in Rajasthan?
(a) Child Marriage led Maternal Deaths
(b) Patriarchal Society
(c) Exposure to Pre-natal Sex Determination
(d) Dowry System
questions.technical_proof: Factors DIRECTLY responsible for low child sex ratio: (b) Patriarchal society (son preference), (c) Pre-natal sex determination leading to female foeticide. Factors NOT directly responsible for low CSR: (a) Child marriage led maternal deaths (this affects maternal mortality, not sex ratio at birth), (d) Dowry system (indirect contributor through son preference but not directly causing sex-selective abortion). So (a) and (d) are not DIRECTLY responsible = Option C.
questions.explanation: (a) Child marriage maternal deaths and (d) Dowry system are indirect/not direct causes of low child sex ratio. Direct causes are (b) and (c).
questions.trap_point: Dowry system leads to son preference but is indirect. Pre-natal sex determination is the direct cause.
questions.memory_trick: Direct CSR causes: Son preference (b) + Sex determination (c). Indirect: Child marriage (a) + Dowry (d).
questions.revision_fact: Low child sex ratio direct causes: Patriarchal society + Pre-natal sex determination.

questions.question_hindi: राजस्थान का कौन-सा जिला हाल ही में महत्वपूर्ण लिथियम भंडार की खोज के लिए चर्चा में था?
questions.question_english: Which district in Rajasthan was recently in the news for the discovery of significant lithium reserves?
questions.technical_proof: Nagaur district of Rajasthan was recently in news for discovery of significant lithium reserves. Rajasthan has emerged as having potential lithium deposits alongside Jammu & Kashmir (Reasi).
questions.explanation: Nagaur district, Rajasthan — significant lithium reserve discovery reported.
questions.trap_point: Barmer is known for oil, not lithium. Nagaur = lithium.
questions.memory_trick: Nagaur = New lithium discovery. Barmer = Oil. Bikaner = Gypsum/coal.
questions.revision_fact: Nagaur district (Rajasthan): site of significant lithium reserve discovery — important for EV batteries.

questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा आर.ए.जे.एस.आई.सी.ओ. (राजस्थान लघु उद्योग निगम) के प्राथमिक कार्य का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन करता है?
questions.question_english: Which of the following best describes the primary function of RAJSICO (Rajasthan Small Industries Corporation)?

options.text: Promoting export-oriented industrial units through financial incentives
Regulating and licensing small-scale industries within the state
Developing small scale industrial infrastructure such as industrial areas and growth centers
Providing marketing support and facilitating supply of raw materials to small-scale industries and artisans

questions.technical_proof: RAJSICO (Rajasthan Small Industries Corporation Limited) primarily provides marketing support to small-scale industries and artisans, and facilitates supply of raw materials to them.
questions.explanation: RAJSICO's primary function: Marketing support + Raw material supply to SSIs and artisans.
questions.trap_point: RIICO handles industrial infrastructure; RAJSICO handles marketing/raw material supply.
questions.memory_trick: RAJSICO = Marketing + Raw materials for Small Industries. RIICO = Industrial areas development.
questions.revision_fact: RAJSICO: Marketing support and raw material supply to small industries and artisans.

questions.question_hindi:
जब सोडियम हाइड्रोजन कार्बोनेट को एसीटिक अम्ल में मिलाया जाता है तो एक गैस निर्मुक्त होती है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन से कथन गैस के निर्मुक्त होने के बारे में सही हैं?
(a) यह चूने के पानी को दूधिया कर देता है।
(b) यह जलती हुई फाँस को बुझा देता है।
(c) यह सोडियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड के विलयन में घुल जाता है।
(d) इसमें तीखी गंध होती है।
questions.question_english:
When Sodium hydrogen carbonate is added to acetic acid a gas evolves. Which of the following statements are true about the gas evolved?
(a) It turns lime water milky.
(b) It extinguishes a burning splinter.
(c) It dissolves in a solution of sodium hydroxide.
(d) It has a pungent odour.
questions.technical_proof: NaHCO₃ + CH₃COOH → CH₃COONa + H₂O + CO₂. The gas is CO₂. (a) CO₂ turns lime water milky (Ca(OH)₂ + CO₂ → CaCO₃ white ppt) = TRUE. (b) CO₂ extinguishes burning splinter = TRUE. (c) CO₂ dissolves in NaOH solution (CO₂ + 2NaOH → Na₂CO₃ + H₂O) = TRUE. (d) CO₂ has NO pungent odour (it is odourless) = FALSE.
questions.explanation: Gas evolved = CO₂. (a),(b),(c) are all true properties of CO₂. (d) is false — CO₂ is odourless.
questions.trap_point: CO₂ is odourless. Students may confuse with SO₂ or NH₃ which have pungent smell.
questions.memory_trick: CO₂: lime milky (a) + extinguishes (b) + dissolves in NaOH (c) = all true. NOT pungent (odourless).
questions.revision_fact: CO₂ properties: turns lime water milky; extinguishes fire; dissolves in NaOH; ODOURLESS (not pungent).

questions.question_hindi: कौन-सी विशेषता भारत में संविधान की सर्वोच्चता सुनिश्चित करती है?
questions.question_english: Which feature ensures supremacy of the Constitution in India?
questions.technical_proof: Judicial Review is the mechanism by which the Supreme Court can strike down laws that are inconsistent with the Constitution, thus ensuring constitutional supremacy. India follows constitutional supremacy (not parliamentary supremacy like UK).
questions.explanation: Judicial Review (Article 13, 32, 226) = mechanism ensuring Constitution is supreme. Courts can declare laws unconstitutional.
questions.trap_point: Parliamentary sovereignty (UK model) = Parliament is supreme. India = Constitution is supreme via Judicial Review.
questions.memory_trick: India = Constitution Supreme = enforced by Judicial Review. UK = Parliament Supreme.
questions.revision_fact: Judicial Review ensures Constitutional Supremacy in India. SC can strike down unconstitutional laws.

questions.question_hindi: एक उत्तल लेंस अपनी से 50 cm की दूरी पर रखी एक सुई का वास्तविक और उल्टा प्रतिबिंब बनाता है। यदि प्रतिबिंब का आकार वस्तु के आकार के बराबर हो, तो सुई को उत्तल लेंस के सामने कहाँ रखा गया है?
questions.question_english: A convex lens forms a real and inverted image of a needle at a distance of 50 cm from it. Where is the needle placed in front of the convex lens if the image is equal to the size of the object?
questions.technical_proof: When object size = image size for a convex lens, the object is placed at 2F (twice the focal length) and image forms at 2F on other side. Image distance = 50 cm (given) = 2F. So object distance = 2F = 50 cm. Object is also at 50 cm from the lens.
questions.explanation: Image = Object size when both are at 2F. Image at 50cm = 2F. Object also at 2F = 50cm.
questions.trap_point: Equal image size means object at 2F. Both object and image are at 2F.
questions.memory_trick: Equal size image → Object at 2F (Center of Curvature equivalent for lens).
questions.revision_fact: Convex lens: equal sized image formed when object is at 2F. Image also at 2F on other side.

questions.question_hindi:
सूची-I (प्रसिद्ध व्यक्तित्व) का सूची-II (उपलब्धि/भूमिका) के साथ मिलान कीजिए:
(a) सुंदर पिचाई → (i) माइक्रोसॉफ्ट के सी ई ओ
(b) सत्य नडेला → (ii) गूगल के सी ई ओ
(c) बी.आर. गवई → (iii) भारत के 52वें मुख्य न्यायाधीश
(d) संजीव खन्ना → (iv) भारत के 51वें मुख्य न्यायाधीश
questions.question_english:
Match List-I (Famous Personality) with List-II (Achievement/Role):
(a) Sundar Pichai → (i) CEO of Microsoft
(b) Satya Nadella → (ii) CEO of Google
(c) B.R. Gavai → (iii) 52nd Chief Justice of India
(d) Sanjiv Khanna → (iv) 51st Chief Justice of India
questions.technical_proof: Sundar Pichai = CEO of Google. Satya Nadella = CEO of Microsoft. Sanjiv Khanna = 51st CJI. B.R. Gavai = 52nd CJI. So: (a)-(ii), (b)-(i), (c)-(iii), (d)-(iv) = Option C.
questions.explanation: Sundar Pichai=Google CEO; Satya Nadella=Microsoft CEO; B.R. Gavai=52nd CJI; Sanjiv Khanna=51st CJI.
questions.trap_point: Students commonly swap Pichai (Google) and Nadella (Microsoft).
questions.memory_trick: Pichai = G for Google. Nadella = M for Microsoft. Gavai = latest/52nd CJI.
questions.revision_fact: Sundar Pichai=Google CEO; Satya Nadella=Microsoft CEO; B.R. Gavai=52nd CJI; Sanjiv Khanna=51st CJI.

questions.question_hindi: कौन-सी परियोजना 'सन सिटी' जोधपुर को पीने का पानी प्रदान करती है?
questions.question_english: Which project provides drinking water to the 'Sun City' Jodhpur?
questions.technical_proof: The Jawai Dam (Jawai Bandh) on the Jawai River, Pali district, is the primary source of drinking water for Jodhpur city (Sun City). It is the largest water reservoir in western Rajasthan.
questions.explanation: Jawai Dam → supplies drinking water to Jodhpur (Sun City). Largest reservoir in western Rajasthan.
questions.trap_point: Bisalpur supplies water to Jaipur. Jawai supplies to Jodhpur.
questions.memory_trick: Jawai → Jodhpur (both start with 'J'). Bisalpur → Jaipur (both 'B' and 'J' pair for capital).
questions.revision_fact: Jawai Dam (Pali) = drinking water source for Jodhpur (Sun City). Bisalpur = Jaipur water source.

questions.question_hindi:
राजस्थान में 'डेयरी क्षेत्र' के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
(a) कुल दूध उत्पादन में राजस्थान का भारत में दूसरा स्थान है।
(b) 'मुख्यमंत्री दुग्ध उत्पादक संबल योजना' के तहत दूध उत्पादकों को ₹5 प्रति लीटर की सब्सिडी प्रदान की जाती है।
(c) राजस्थान सहकारी डेयरी फेडरेशन (आर.सी.डी.एफ.) की स्थापना वर्ष 1977 में की गई थी।
(d) 'सरस अमृतम' दूध की गुणवत्ता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए शुरू किया गया एक अभियान है।
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Dairy Sector' in Rajasthan:
(a) Rajasthan ranks 2nd in India for total milk production.
(b) The 'Mukhyamantri Dugdh Utpadak Sambal Yojana' provides a subsidy of ₹5 per litre to milk producers.
(c) The Rajasthan Cooperative Dairy Federation (RCDF) was established in the year 1977.
(d) 'Saras Amritam' is a campaign launched to ensure the quality of milk.
questions.technical_proof: Checking each statement: (a) Rajasthan ranks 2nd in India for milk production — this needs verification. Per recent data, Rajasthan may rank 2nd or differ. (b) MDUSSY subsidy ₹5 per litre — needs verification of current rate. (c) RCDF established 1977 — TRUE. (d) Saras Amritam is a quality campaign — needs verification.
questions.explanation: Paper marks C (b), (c), (d) only — implying (a) is incorrect (Rajasthan may not rank 2nd). Needs official data confirmation.
questions.trap_point: Rajasthan's milk production rank changes — always verify with latest data.
questions.memory_trick: RCDF = 1977. Saras = RCDF brand. Mukhyamantri Dugdh Yojana = ₹5 subsidy.
questions.revision_fact: RCDF established 1977. Rajasthan is among top milk producing states. Saras is RCDF's brand.

questions.question_hindi: 8 और 98 के बीच का माध्यानुपाती है:
questions.question_english: The mean proportional between 8 and 98 is:
questions.technical_proof: Mean proportional between a and b = √(a×b). √(8×98) = √784 = 28.
questions.explanation: Mean proportional = √(8×98) = √784 = 28.
questions.trap_point: Mean proportional = geometric mean = square root of product. Not arithmetic mean.
questions.memory_trick: Mean proportional = √(product). 8×98 = 784. √784 = 28.
questions.revision_fact: Mean proportional between a and b = √(ab). For 8 and 98 = √784 = 28.

questions.question_hindi: भारतीय दंड संहिता (आई.पी.सी.) 1860 को किस कानून ने प्रतिस्थापित किया और 1 जुलाई 2024 को पूर्ण रूप से प्रभावी हुआ?
questions.question_english: Which legislation replaced the Indian Penal Code (IPC) 1860 and came into full effect on 1st July 2024?
questions.technical_proof: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) replaced IPC 1860. Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) replaced CrPC. Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) replaced Indian Evidence Act. All three came into effect on 1 July 2024.
questions.explanation: BNS = replaced IPC. BNSS = replaced CrPC. BSA = replaced Indian Evidence Act. All effective 1 July 2024.
questions.trap_point: Three new laws came at once: BNS (IPC), BNSS (CrPC), BSA (Evidence Act). Don't confuse which replaced which.
questions.memory_trick: BNS = Nyaya (Justice) = replaced IPC (Penal Code). N for N.
questions.revision_fact: IPC replaced by BNS; CrPC replaced by BNSS; Evidence Act replaced by BSA — all from 1 July 2024.

questions.question_hindi: बहादुरी, बलिदान और शहादत के लिए पूजित एक लोक देवता जो हाथ में भाला लिए हुए एक घुड़सवार के लोकप्रिय प्रतीक चिन्ह के तौर पर जाना जाता है, उसकी पहचान कीजिए।
questions.question_english: A folk deity worshipped for bravery, sacrifice and martyrdom is known for a popular insignia of a horseman with a spear in his hand. Identify the deity:
questions.technical_proof: Pabuji is a folk deity of Rajasthan, particularly revered in western Rajasthan. He is depicted as a warrior on a black mare (Kesar Kalami), holding a spear. He is worshipped for bravery and sacrifice.
questions.explanation: Pabuji = Rajasthani folk deity = depicted as horseman with spear = worshipped for bravery, sacrifice.
questions.trap_point: Tejaji is snake deity (saves snake bite victims). Pabuji is warrior deity with spear.
questions.memory_trick: Pabuji = horse + spear = warrior deity. Tejaji = snake god. Ramdevji = saint-deity.
questions.revision_fact: Pabuji: Rajasthani folk deity, depicted on black horse with spear, worshipped for bravery.

questions.question_hindi: भारत की 'हरित क्रांति' में उनकी भूमिका के लिए 2024 में मरणोपरांत 'भारत रत्न' से किसे सम्मानित किया गया?
questions.question_english: Who was awarded the 'Bharat Ratna' posthumously in 2024 for his role in the 'Green Revolution' of India?
questions.technical_proof: M.S. Swaminathan, the father of India's Green Revolution, was awarded the Bharat Ratna posthumously in 2024. Other 2024 Bharat Ratna recipients included P.V. Narasimha Rao, Karpoori Thakur, Chaudhary Charan Singh, and L.K. Advani.
questions.explanation: M.S. Swaminathan = Bharat Ratna 2024 = posthumous = Green Revolution father.
questions.trap_point: Multiple Bharat Ratna 2024 awardees — Swaminathan specifically linked to Green Revolution.
questions.memory_trick: Swaminathan = Wheat Revolution Father = Bharat Ratna 2024 posthumous.
questions.revision_fact: Bharat Ratna 2024 for Green Revolution: M.S. Swaminathan (posthumous). Others: PV Narasimha Rao, Karpoori Thakur, Charan Singh, LK Advani.

questions.question_hindi:
निम्नलिखित में से राजस्थान के महावीर चक्र विजेताओं की पहचान कीजिए:
(a) सूबेदार चूनाराम फगेरिया
(b) ब्रिगेडियर रघुवीर सिंह राजावत
(c) शहीद सैनिक ढोंकल सिंह
(d) शहीद मेजर शैतान सिंह
questions.question_english:
Identify from the following the Mahavir Chakra winners of Rajasthan:
(a) Subedar Choonaram Fageria
(b) Brigadier Raghuveer Singh Rajawat
(c) Shaheed Soldier Dhonkal Singh
(d) Shaheed Major Shaitan Singh
questions.technical_proof: Major Shaitan Singh was awarded Param Vir Chakra (not Mahavir Chakra) for Rezang La battle (1962). Needs verification of who among these specifically received Mahavir Chakra.
questions.explanation: Paper marks (b),(c),(d) as Mahavir Chakra winners from Rajasthan. Major Shaitan Singh received PVC — this may be an error in the question.
questions.trap_point: Major Shaitan Singh = Param Vir Chakra (highest), not Mahavir Chakra.
questions.memory_trick: PVC > MVC > VrC. Shaitan Singh = PVC (Rezang La, 1962).
questions.revision_fact: Major Shaitan Singh = Param Vir Chakra (1963, posthumous) for Rezang La battle, 1962.
questions.review_status: Needs Verification - Major Shaitan Singh received PVC not MVC

questions.question_hindi: उस नृत्य रूप की पहचान कीजिए जिसमें नकाबपोश महिलाएँ काँच या तलवार के किनारे पर झूमते हुए अपने सिर पर पीतल के बर्तनों को संतुलित करती हैं।
questions.question_english: Identify the dance form in which veiled women balance brass pots on their heads while swaying on top of a glass or edge of a sword:
questions.technical_proof: Bhavai dance is the Rajasthani folk dance where performers (veiled women) balance brass pots on their heads while dancing on the edge of a sword or glass. It is performed mainly in Mewar region.
questions.explanation: Bhavai dance = balancing brass pots on head while dancing on sword/glass edge. Mewar region.
questions.trap_point: Terah Taali = 13 cymbals dance. Kalbelia = snake charmer dance. Bhavai = pot balancing on sword.
questions.memory_trick: Bhavai = Brave = balancing on sword edge. Terah Taali = 13 cymbal beats.
questions.revision_fact: Bhavai dance: brass pots balanced on head, dancing on sword/glass edge. Rajasthani folk dance.

questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक धातु है?
questions.question_english: Which of the following is a metal?
questions.technical_proof: Lead (Pb) is a metal. Sulphur (S), Iodine (I), and Bromine (Br) are all non-metals. Bromine is a liquid non-metal at room temperature.
questions.explanation: Lead = metal. Sulphur, Iodine, Bromine = non-metals.
questions.trap_point: Bromine is a liquid but it is a NON-metal. Students may confuse liquid = metal.
questions.memory_trick: Lead = heavy metal = Pb. Sulphur, Iodine, Bromine = non-metals.
questions.revision_fact: Lead (Pb) = metal. Sulphur, Iodine, Bromine = non-metals. Bromine is only liquid non-metal.

questions.question_hindi:
निम्नलिखित को प्रशासनिक पदानुक्रम के बढ़ते क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए:
(a) तहसील, (b) उप-मंडल, (c) जिला, (d) प्रभाग
questions.question_english:
Arrange the following in increasing order of administrative hierarchy:
(a) Tehsil, (b) Sub-Division, (c) District, (d) Division
questions.technical_proof: Administrative hierarchy in Rajasthan (smallest to largest): Tehsil < Sub-Division < District < Division. So (a)<(b)<(c)<(d) = Option B.
questions.explanation: Hierarchy: Tehsil → Sub-Division → District → Division. Option B: (a),(b),(c),(d).
questions.trap_point: Some students place Sub-Division above Tehsil correctly but then swap District and Division.
questions.memory_trick: T-S-D-D: Tehsil < Sub-Division < District < Division. Ascending alphabet order helps: T→S→D→D.
questions.revision_fact: Rajasthan administrative order (small to large): Tehsil → Sub-Division → District → Division.

questions.question_hindi: लोहे के औजार मिलने वाली इन जगहों में से कौन-सी जगह भारत में लौह युग की शुरुआत की तारीख तय करने के लिए जरूरी मानी जाती है?
questions.question_english: Which of the following sites, yielding iron tools, is considered significant to fix the date for the advent of Iron Age in India?
questions.technical_proof: Rairh (Nalachha), Tonk district, Rajasthan is a significant archaeological site with extensive iron tool findings that are important for fixing the date of India's Iron Age. It has yielded thousands of iron artifacts.
questions.explanation: Rairh (Tonk) is the most significant Iron Age archaeological site in Rajasthan, with extensive iron tool deposits.
questions.trap_point: Noh (Bharatpur) also has iron age findings but Rairh is most significant for dating Iron Age.
questions.memory_trick: Rairh (Tonk) = Raj's Iron = Rajasthan's most significant Iron Age site.
questions.revision_fact: Rairh (Tonk, Rajasthan) = Most significant site for Iron Age dating in India; extensive iron artifacts found.

questions.question_hindi: मौलिक कर्तव्यों को किस संशोधन द्वारा जोड़ा गया था?
questions.question_english: Fundamental Duties were added by which amendment?
questions.technical_proof: Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976 (during Emergency). They are contained in Article 51-A. Originally 10 duties; an 11th was added by 86th Amendment (2002).
questions.explanation: 42nd Amendment (1976) added 10 Fundamental Duties (Art. 51-A). 86th Amendment (2002) added the 11th duty.
questions.trap_point: 86th amendment added the 11th duty but original Fundamental Duties were by 42nd amendment.
questions.memory_trick: 42nd Amendment = Emergency era = Fundamental Duties added. 86 = 11th duty added.
questions.revision_fact: Fundamental Duties: 42nd Amendment 1976 (10 duties). 86th Amendment 2002 (11th duty). Article 51-A.

questions.question_hindi:
पुष्पी पादपों में दिखाई देने वाली प्रजनन अवस्थाओं का सही क्रम है:
(a) नवोद्भिद्, (b) युग्मक, (c) युग्मनज, (d) भ्रूण
questions.question_english:
The correct sequence of reproductive stages seen in flowering plants is:
(a) Seedling, (b) Gametes, (c) Zygote, (d) Embryo
questions.technical_proof: Reproductive sequence in flowering plants: Gametes (b) → fertilization → Zygote (c) → develops into Embryo (d) → germinates into Seedling (a). So (b), (c), (d), (a) = Option C.
questions.explanation: Sequence: Gametes → Zygote → Embryo → Seedling. Option C: (b),(c),(d),(a).
questions.trap_point: Students may start with Seedling as beginning of life cycle but reproductive stage begins with Gametes.
questions.memory_trick: GZES = Gametes → Zygote → Embryo → Seedling. Go Zip Every Step.
questions.revision_fact: Flowering plant reproduction: Gametes → Zygote → Embryo → Seedling (in sequence).

questions.question_hindi: जब प्रकाश किरण एक माध्यम से दूसरे माध्यम में जाती है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा गुण अपरिवर्तित रहता है?
questions.question_english: When the light ray travels from one medium to another medium, which of the following property remains unchanged?
questions.technical_proof: When light travels from one medium to another: frequency remains constant (unchanged). Speed, wavelength change. Amplitude may change at interface. Frequency is determined by the source and doesn't change with medium.
questions.explanation: Frequency of light is invariant when passing between media. Speed and wavelength change (v=fλ, so if v changes and f is constant, λ changes).
questions.trap_point: Many students think wavelength stays constant, but it's FREQUENCY that stays constant.
questions.memory_trick: Frequency = Fixed (from source). Speed = changes with medium. Wavelength = changes with speed.
questions.revision_fact: Light in different media: Frequency stays CONSTANT. Speed and Wavelength change. c=fλ.

questions.question_hindi: एक वृत्त की त्रिज्या क्या है जिसका क्षेत्रफल दो वृत्तों के क्षेत्रफल के योग के बराबर है जिनकी त्रिज्याएँ 20 cm और 21 cm हैं?
questions.question_english: What is the radius of a circle whose area is equal to the sum of the areas of two circles whose radii are 20 cm and 21 cm?
questions.trap_point: Students may add radii directly (20+21=41) but must use area formula and then find square root.
questions.memory_trick: Pythagorean-like: R² = r₁² + r₂². 20-21-29 is a Pythagorean triplet!
questions.revision_fact: Area sum of circles: R² = r₁² + r₂². 20-21-29 is a Pythagorean triple.

questions.question_hindi: ऋग्वेद में उल्लिखित प्राचीन क्षेत्रों के नामों में से, राजस्थान का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा भाग 'मारू' से जुड़ा हुआ है?
questions.question_english: Among the names of ancient territories mentioned in the Rigveda, which of the following parts of Rajasthan is associated with 'Maru'?
questions.technical_proof: 'Maru' is the ancient Vedic name for the desert region (Thar Desert) in western Rajasthan. Jodhpur (and the broader Marwar region) is associated with 'Maru' in ancient texts. 'Marwar' literally derives from 'Maru Pradesh' = Land of Death/Desert.
questions.explanation: 'Maru' = ancient Vedic name for Thar Desert region = Jodhpur/Marwar. 'Marwar' = Maru Pradesh.
questions.trap_point: Maru = Marwar = Jodhpur region (not Jaipur or Bikaner).
questions.memory_trick: Maru → Mar-war → Jodhpur. Desert = Maru. Marwar = Maru Pradesh.
questions.revision_fact: 'Maru' in Rigveda = ancient Thar Desert/Jodhpur region. Marwar derives from Maru Pradesh.

questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा भारत को 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष राज्य' के रूप में वर्णित करता है?
questions.question_english: Which of the following describes India as a 'Secular State'?
questions.technical_proof: The word 'Secular' was added to the Preamble by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976. The Preamble describes India as a 'Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic Republic'.
questions.explanation: Preamble contains the word 'Secular' (added by 42nd Amendment 1976). It officially describes India as a secular state.
questions.trap_point: Secular is in the PREAMBLE, not in Fundamental Rights or Directive Principles directly.
questions.memory_trick: SSSD-R in Preamble: Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic. S³DR = Preamble.
questions.revision_fact: India = Secular State as per Preamble. 'Secular' added by 42nd Amendment (1976).

questions.question_hindi: राजस्थानी चित्रकला की किस शैली के कलाकारों ने ऐसे पाठ-चित्रण और लघुचित्रों का सृजन किया है, जो दुनिया भर के संग्रहालयों में प्रदर्शन के योग्य हैं?
questions.question_english: The artists of which school of Rajasthani painting have produced text illustrations and miniatures worthy of exhibition in the museums world over?
questions.technical_proof: Bundi School of Painting is renowned for its miniature paintings and text illustrations (particularly from Ragamala series, hunting scenes, etc.) that are exhibited in museums worldwide. It is one of the most celebrated Rajasthani painting schools.
questions.explanation: Bundi School of Painting = world-famous miniatures displayed in museums worldwide. Known for Ragamala paintings.
questions.trap_point: Kota painting style also produces good miniatures but Bundi is specifically world-famous for museum-quality works.
questions.memory_trick: Bundi = Beautiful = Best Rajasthani miniatures = Displayed in global museums.
questions.revision_fact: Bundi School of Painting: Famous for miniature text illustrations displayed in museums worldwide.

questions.question_hindi: राजस्थान का राज्य मानवाधिकार आयोग (एस.एच.आर.सी.) किस वर्ष कार्यशील हुआ?
questions.question_english: The State Human Rights Commission (SHRC) of Rajasthan became functional in which year?
questions.technical_proof: Rajasthan SHRC was constituted in 1999 and became functional in 2000. The Protection of Human Rights Act 1993 established the framework. National Human Rights Commission was established in 1993.
questions.explanation: Rajasthan State Human Rights Commission became functional in 2000. National HRC established 1993.
questions.trap_point: National HRC = 1993. Rajasthan SHRC = 2000 (functional).
questions.memory_trick: NHRC = 1993. Rajasthan SHRC = 2000. 7 years gap.
questions.revision_fact: Rajasthan SHRC became functional in 2000. NHRC established under Protection of Human Rights Act 1993.

questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से मेवाड़ प्रजा मंडल के संस्थापक की पहचान कीजिए।
questions.question_english: Identify the founder of Mewar Praja Mandal from the following:
questions.technical_proof: Manikyalal Verma founded the Mewar Praja Mandal in 1938. He was a prominent freedom fighter from Rajasthan and worked for the liberation of Mewar's people from princely rule.
questions.explanation: Manikyalal Verma = Founder of Mewar Praja Mandal (1938) = freedom fighter from Mewar.
questions.trap_point: Multiple Praja Mandals in different regions — match each to correct founder.
questions.memory_trick: Mewar = Manikyalal Verma. Both start with 'M'.
questions.revision_fact: Mewar Praja Mandal (1938): Founded by Manikyalal Verma. Led movement against Mewar princely rule.

questions.question_hindi: राजस्थान भूमि राजस्व (संशोधन और वैधीकरण) अधिनियम, 2025, मुख्य रूप से किस संस्थान की शक्तियों का विस्तार करने के लिए अधिनियमित किया गया था?
